* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Mercer County in northwestern Pennsylvania...
Northern Butler County in west central Pennsylvania...
Central Lawrence County in western Pennsylvania...

mobile homes, roofs, and outbuildings.

Wilmington, Oakwood, New Castle Northwest, Prospect, Plain Grove
Township, South New Castle, West Liberty, Harlansburg,
Portersville, West Sunbury, Volant, Cooper's Lake Campground, Rose
Point Park, McConnells Mill and Moraine State Park.

events.region: Coastal waters from Tarpon Springs to Suwannee River FL out 20 NM
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWTBW

The National Weather Service in Ruskin has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Tarpon Springs to Suwannee River FL out 20
NM...

* Until 530 PM EDT.

* At 454 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm producing waterspouts was
located offshore near Ozello. The severe thunderstorm was nearly
stationary.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can capsize boats, damage vessels, and create
suddenly higher waves. Make sure all on board are in a
secure location and wearing life jackets. Expect wind
gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher waves,
frequent lightning, and heavy downpours. Make sure all on
board are wearing life jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Ozello, Yankeetown, and Crystal River.

events.region: Ashtabula, OH; Trumbull, OH; Crawford, PA
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southeastern Ashtabula County in northeastern Ohio...
Northeastern Trumbull County in northeastern Ohio...
Crawford County in northwestern Pennsylvania...

* WHEN...Until 800 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 453 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Meadville, Cortland, Titusville, Kinsman, Andover, Linesville,
Harmonsburg, Atlantic, Adamsville, Pymatuning Central, Pymatuning
North, Guys Mills, Mecca, Johnston, Cochranton, Saegertown,
Cherry Valley, Conneaut Lake, Hydetown and Blooming Valley.
- Please visit www.weather.gov/safety/flood for flood safety and
preparedness information.

events.summary:
Forsyth County Office of Environmental Assistance and Protection
Winston-Salem NC has issued a Code Orange Air Quality Action Day for
the Triad region for Ground Level Ozone, until 8 PM EDT this
evening, and again for Friday.

An Air Quality Action Day means that Ground Level Ozone
concentrations within the region may approach or exceed unhealthy
standards. For additional information, please visit the Forsyth
County Environmental Affairs Department Web site at
www.co.forsyth.nc.us/eap/dailyforecast.aspx
